changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Voters in six states head to the polls Tuesday for high-profile primaries, Trump signals his strategy with Iran is shifting, 7.4 magnitude earthquake kills at least 111 people in Colombia.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: A U.S. official tells NBC News that President Trump's team used an elaborate ruse to fly him out of Turkey after the NATO Summit amid threats to his life during the Iran war. NBC News' Shannon Pettypiece has details on the plan to keep the president's true location hidden.

changes.title: Trump took a secret flight out of Turkey in an elaborate plot to hide his location amid Iran war
changes.summary: President Donald Trump was whisked out of Turkey last month on a military aircraft in an elaborate plot to keep his location secret amid security fears from the war with neighboring Iran, according to a U.S. official with knowledge of the plan.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Donald Trump secretly flew out of last month's NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on an alternate military aircraft while the White House made it appear that the Republican president was flying on Air Force One, according to a report published by The Washington Post on Monday.

changes.title: Egyptian blue in Iron Age Iran points to ancient connections
changes.summary: Egyptian blue, considered the world's earliest synthetic pigment, was prized for its stable blue hues and served as a common blue paint in Egypt as early as 5,000 years ago, as well as the base material for small items such as beads and vessels in later periods.

changes.title: Trump pivots back to sanctions for Iran as other strategies to end his war fizzle
changes.summary: The shift comes as U.S. stockpiles of key weapons have dwindled and as stop-start talks seem again to have stalled. But Trump insists the pressure can lead to a breakthrough. (Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson).
